applied.problem: "Sits on the same shaft" does not make two gears turn together (gears can run free on a shaft); "work out equals work in" holds only at steady speed, not while the gears speed up; the direction flip holds for outside teeth on side-by-side shafts, not bevel or worm meshes.

"Gears on one shaft turn the same way" fails for gears running free on a shaft, as in many gearboxes; only gears fixed to it do. "Each mesh flips it" holds for outside teeth on side-by-side shafts, not for bevel or worm meshes.
Screen 7 hint: an idler does not pass on the speed unchanged in rev/min (it turns at its own speed set by its teeth); what it leaves unchanged is the ratio between the gears either side of it.
